comment: Isometric tile adjacency (Tile Layout Lab). Each base image is a SQUARE with an isometric diamond top face; a neighbor sits across each diamond edge at a screen offset of (±w, ±h) × image size — EACH SIDE HAS ITS OWN magnitudes. ne = up-right, se = down-right, sw = down-left, nw = up-left. Current values are EXACT for base_garden_uniform, derived from its geometry (perspective-normalised to a perfect diamond: half-width 935px, slope 0.8, on 2048px → w=935/2048, h=748/2048). Hand-tuned values for the older bases were 0.53/0.4 — retune in the lab if switching art.

kingdomNeighbor.comment: Gameplay preview: renders ONE neighbor tile beside the Kingdom's centre island using the side offsets above. enabled=false turns the effect off; baseId=null uses the same art as the centre island.
